# Backyard Pool Tips

> Independent pool equipment reviews and maintenance advice for backyard pool owners, written by Tom and Shirley Springsteen from 30 years running a pool shop. Buying guides start with the pool, not the product; recommendations are based on running cost and practical suitability, not commission.

## Maintenance guides

- [Cloudy Water? Start Here.](https://backyardpooltips.com/cloudy-water): A complete, step-by-step guide to fixing cloudy pool water — testing, balancing, and filtering in the right order, every likely cause explained, and the mistake that makes it worse.
- [Opening a Pool the Right Way](https://backyardpooltips.com/opening-a-pool): The correct order of operations for opening a pool for the season — cover off, prime the pump, balance before you shock.
- [Closing a Pool for Winter](https://backyardpooltips.com/closing-a-pool): What to drain, what to leave alone, and the step most guides skip when winterizing.
- [Common Pump & Filter Problems](https://backyardpooltips.com/pump-filter-problems): Symptom-to-fix troubleshooting for losing prime, short cycling, rising pressure, weak flow, and cloudy water.

## About

- [About Backyard Pool Tips](https://backyardpooltips.com/about): Who runs the site and how recommendations are made.
- [Affiliate Disclosure](https://backyardpooltips.com/affiliate-disclosure): How Amazon Associates links work on this site and what they do and don't change.
- [Privacy Policy](https://backyardpooltips.com/privacy-policy): What data is collected and how it's used.

## Notes

Buying guides for pool pumps, covers, and cleaning equipment are in progress and will be added to this file as they're published.
